description: 230 flags of the world's countries and territories, in both directions: from a flag to its place, from a place to its flag. Each flag keeps its real proportions and colors, and every answer can show the place's continent and region. Deck © Simon Pinkas, CC BY 4.0; the flag drawings are public domain or CC0. Credits and sources: https://github.com/rectoversohq/rectoverso-flags
